name: Dogface Ink
medium: frontline one-panel gag cartoon, brush ink and crayon
prompt: Single-panel 1940s frontline newspaper gag cartoon, black brush ink and grease crayon on rough off-white newsprint. An American infantryman sits on an ammunition crate in a muddy foxhole, squared to the viewer, wool overcoat collar turned up high to the helmet strap, scarf, thick gloves holding a tin cup. His M1 steel helmet is pulled low and everything under the brim is one solid pool of black ink. Heavy slashing brush strokes, deep spotted blacks, scratchy crayon tone on the mud and sky, sagging tired posture. Wide blank strip of paper below the drawing reserved for a typed caption. Slight ink bleed, visible paper fibre.

name: Four-Colour Misprint
medium: photographed panel from a ten-cent newsprint comic book
prompt: Photograph of a single panel from a 1940s ten-cent war comic book, printed on yellowed newsprint, shot flat under warm lamp light. An American G.I. stands at attention in olive drab field jacket, leather gloves and canvas leggings in front of a canvas tent. Bold black brush outlines, flat four-colour inks, coarse visible halftone dots, olive, khaki, brick red and pale yellow. The black printing plate has slipped out of register, so a thick slab of solid black ink sits across the whole opening beneath his steel helmet brim while colour fringes peek at every outline. Empty white speech balloon above, blank caption box in the corner, paper grain, slight page curl.

name: Passed by Censor
medium: press photograph handled by a military censor
prompt: 1940s US Army Signal Corps press photograph, black-and-white silver gelatin print with white border, lying on a wooden desk. A soldier in wool service uniform, gloves and M1 steel helmet sits upright on a folding chair in front of a tent, hands on knees. A military censor has painted one neat rectangle of opaque black ink over the area under the helmet brim, brush edges visible, and a purple rubber stamp reading PASSED BY EXAMINER sits at an angle in the corner. Grease-pencil crop marks in the margin, typed caption slip pasted along the bottom edge, soft window light, shallow depth of field on the print surface.

name: Front-Page Halftone
prompt: Extreme close view of a 1940s newspaper front page photograph, coarse halftone dot screen on grey newsprint, black ink only. An American soldier in field jacket, scarf and gloves leans on a jeep bonnet, M1 steel helmet tilted forward. The shadow under the helmet brim has filled in completely, the dots merging into one solid black patch of ink, while the jacket, jeep and sky stay in open, clearly separated dots. Bold condensed headline type cropped at the top edge, narrow caption line beneath the picture, a soft fold crease crossing the page, slight ink offset from the facing page, warm reading-lamp light on the paper.

name: Shadow Cel
prompt: Frame from a 1940s Technicolor theatrical cartoon, hand-inked cel over a painted gouache background. A realistically proportioned American soldier in olive uniform, gloves and steel helmet stands in a night-time guard post under a single hanging lamp. Dramatic low camera angle, art deco composition, long diagonal shadows. Clean dark ink outlines, flat cel colours with one hard-edged shadow tone, and the lamp directly overhead turns everything beneath the helmet brim into a single flat black shadow shape. Painted background in deep teal, rust and amber with a soft airbrushed light cone, subtle cel dust and film grain, 4:3 frame.

name: Training Film Private
prompt: Frame from a 1940s black-and-white army training cartoon, rubbery theatrical cartoon style, grey-wash painted background of a barracks yard. A short, round-shouldered private in baggy fatigues, oversized gloves and enormous boots salutes proudly. His steel helmet is three sizes too large and has dropped down over his head so its rim rests on his collar, with a small gap of solid black beneath the rim. Thick confident ink outlines, simple grey cel tones, squash-and-stretch pose, a big hand-painted arrow sign reading WRONG pointing at him, soft film grain, slight gate weave, 4:3 frame.

name: Security Poster
prompt: 1940s wartime security poster, stone lithograph with flat silkscreen-like colour, printed on heavy cream paper with pinholes in the corners. A monumental American soldier seen from the chest up in olive greatcoat with collar raised, one gloved hand lifted with index finger upright in front of the helmet, steel helmet rendered in three flat tones. Under the helmet brim sits one clean, flat, solid black shape, graphic and geometric. Limited palette of olive, signal red, cream and black, soft airbrushed gradient in the background, strong diagonal composition, wide blank cream band along the bottom reserved for a slogan, small government printing line at the lower edge.

name: Work-relief poster
medium: silkscreen print in four flat inks
prompt: 1930s American work-relief poster, hand-pulled silkscreen print in four flat ink colours: mustard yellow, rust red, deep navy, cream paper stock. A single standing figure in patched denim overalls, a wool coat, work gloves and heavy boots fills the frame from the knees up, centred. The head is a dusty burlap feed sack tied at the collar with twine, printed as one solid mustard shape with rust cross-hatch weave and a single stitched seam, a battered felt hat on top. Bold simplified shapes, hard stencil edges, slight ink misregistration, visible paper grain, navy sky above a low rust horizon with one leaning fence post. Wide empty cream band along the bottom edge.

name: Carved-wood puppet
medium: tabletop stop-motion puppet, late-1930s Technicolor short
prompt: Tabletop stop-motion puppet from a late-1930s Technicolor theatrical short. A hand-carved, lathe-turned wooden puppet twenty centimetres tall stands on a miniature dust-blown farm porch. Its body is painted wood dressed in tiny stitched denim overalls, a wool coat, knitted mittens and leather boots. Its head is a small burlap sack stuffed plump and smooth, cinched at the collar with twine, one seam down the front, a felt hat on top. Glossy enamel paint, visible wood grain and lathe rings, miniature props, painted backdrop of a yellow dust sky, warm key light from the left, shallow depth of field, saturated three-strip colour, fine film grain.

name: Scarecrow photograph
medium: 1936 documentary photograph, subject is a scarecrow
prompt: Black-and-white documentary photograph, 1936, large-format camera, fine silver grain, soft overcast light. A scarecrow sits upright on a wooden kitchen chair on a farmhouse porch, posed like an interview subject, framed from the knees up, centred. Its head is a plain burlap feed sack packed tight with straw, smooth and rounded, tied at the collar with twine, one coarse seam down the front, a battered felt hat on top. Straw pokes from the shirt collar and from both coat cuffs above stuffed work gloves. Patched denim overalls, wool coat, dust on every surface, flat plains and a leaning fence behind, deep focus.

name: Felt puppet
medium: stop-motion puppet from a 1960s TV holiday special
prompt: Stop-motion puppet from a 1960s television holiday special, photographed on a miniature set. A small puppet body, twenty centimetres tall, built on a wire armature and wrapped in felt and wool: ankle-length paisley kaftan in orange and purple, crocheted shawl, felt mittens, beaded necklaces, knitted slippers, round spectacles hanging on a bead chain. Fixed into the kaftan's high collar, brass base hidden by the shawl, is a miniature glowing lava lamp: a tapered glass bottle of amber liquid with slow magenta wax blobs and a brass cap. She sits in a tiny rocking chair on a set with daisy wallpaper and a shag rug. Soft warm studio lighting, visible felt fibres, 16mm colour film grain.

name: Psychedelic cel
prompt: Frame from a 1968 psychedelic animated feature, hand-inked cel animation with flat poster colours. A tall seated figure drawn as one continuous bell-shaped kaftan from collar to floor, covered in swirling paisley and flower patterns in hot pink, orange, lime and violet, sleeves ending in white gloves holding knitting needles. Rising from the collar is a lava lamp shape: a tapered bottle in thick black outline, filled with flat orange and three floating magenta blobs, a small silver cap on top. Background of concentric rainbow sunbursts and Art Nouveau curls, thin black outlines, flat colour fills, slight cel dust and gate weave, 4:3 frame.

name: Light-show silhouette
prompt: 1967 colour photograph on 35mm slide film, inside a ballroom during a liquid light show. A seated figure in a floor-length kaftan, long gloves and a fringed shawl appears as a crisp dark silhouette against a huge rear-projection screen of swirling oil-and-dye bubbles in magenta, amber and turquoise. Standing on the figure's shoulders, brass base tucked inside the high collar, is a real glowing lava lamp: a tapered glass bottle of amber liquid with slow red wax blobs and a brass cap, the brightest object in the frame. Rocking chair, knitting in the lap, strong backlight, soft halation around the lamp, saturated film colour, visible grain.

name: 1985 broadcast CGI
prompt: Still frame from a 1985 computer-animated music video, flat-shaded polygon graphics rendered on a broadcast video system. A blocky character built from simple solids sits behind a desk: a boxy charcoal pinstripe suit torso with wide wedge shoulder pads, a red rectangular power tie, cuboid arms ending in white mitten blocks holding a brick-sized mobile phone. Rising from the white shirt collar is a stacked totem of primitives: a yellow cylinder, a tilted pink triangular prism, a turquoise sphere and a black-and-white squiggle-patterned cone on top. Hard-edged facets, solid saturated colours, gradient backdrop with a neon grid, soft video scanlines, slight colour bleed, 4:3 frame.

name: Cut-paper collage
medium: stop-motion cut paper on an animation stand
prompt: Stop-motion cut-paper collage in early-1980s music-television ident style, photographed from above on an animation stand. A figure assembled from cut paper and plastic laminate chips: a grey pinstripe paper suit jacket with huge triangular shoulders, a white paper shirt collar, a red tie, paper gloves holding a paper briefcase. Above the collar, pasted flat on the pastel background, a cluster of geometric cutouts: a yellow circle, a pink triangle, a turquoise zigzag, a black-and-white squiggle-print rectangle, each casting a thin soft shadow. Terrazzo-speckled mint background, crisp scissor edges, visible paper fibre and glue ripple, even copy-stand lighting.

name: Solid totem photograph
prompt: 1986 colour photograph on 35mm film, direct flash, glossy magazine advertising look. A seated executive figure in a double-breasted charcoal pinstripe power suit with wide padded shoulders, white shirt buttoned to the top, red silk tie, black leather gloves, hands folded on a glass desk beside a brick-sized mobile phone. Seated firmly in the shirt collar like a lamp in its socket is a solid postmodern sculpture: a stacked totem of glossy laminate solids, yellow cylinder base filling the collar, pink tilted wedge, turquoise sphere, black-and-white squiggle-patterned cone on top. Pastel office with a glass-brick wall and venetian-blind shadows, saturated colour, sharp focus, film grain.

name: Webcam mosaic
prompt: Frame from a 2004 webcam video, 320 by 240 pixels, chunky compression blocks, washed colour, soft focus, slightly high camera angle from the top of a monitor. A slouched figure in an oversized black zip hoodie with the hood up sits at a cluttered computer desk in a dark bedroom, lit by cold blue screen glow from the left. The entire hood opening is covered by a large square censor mosaic, a ten-by-ten grid of flat blocks in charcoal, violet and black, like the privacy blur on a television news interview. Black knit gloves on a keyboard, studded belt, wallet chain, band posters, energy drink cans, tangled cables, video noise.

name: Low-poly PC tower
prompt: Screenshot from a 2002 console video game cutscene, real-time low-polygon 3D graphics at 480i. A character model with visibly faceted shoulders and blocky mitten hands wears a black hoodie, baggy cargo trousers with a wallet chain, and skate shoes, textures soft and low-resolution. Mounted on the hoodie collar is a tall black desktop computer tower: a vertical rectangular case with two disc-drive trays, a round power button, an acrylic side window glowing electric blue, and orange flame decals along the side. Dim bedroom environment with flat-lit posters and a single blue point light, jagged aliased edges, slight texture shimmer, 4:3 frame, subtle interlace lines.

name: Web-cartoon flip phone
prompt: Frame from an early-2000s web cartoon made in vector animation software, 550 by 400 pixel stage. Thick uniform black outlines, flat colour fills with one darker shade for shadow, radial-gradient background in dark red and black. A slouching character in a black hoodie, studded belt, baggy jeans with a wallet chain and chunky skate shoes, both hands buried in the hoodie pocket. Rising from the hood is a giant silver clamshell mobile phone standing open: a small square screen glowing blue with a pixel-flame wallpaper on the upper half, a numeric keypad on the lower half, a stubby antenna on top. Slightly stiff pose, simple cast shadow, a loading bar along the bottom edge.
